entities.name: Zlatan Stipišić Gibonni

entities.summary: Zlatan Stipišić, also known as Gibonni, is a Croatian singer-songwriter and composer. He is one of the most successful and awarded recording artists from Croatia, receiving record-high 43 Porin music awards for his albums and songs.
